name: ZOUR x BITEZ Micros 3,000MG Gummies - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Blueberry Lime
description: Blueberry Lime is when a juicy, jammy blueberry gets hit with a sharp squeeze of zesty lime, creating a sweet-tart flavor that starts berry-forward and finishes with a bright citrus snap. This next-level Ocho Extracts x Zour Stash collab packs a 500mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend per gummy—half the punch of the original BITEZ for a smoother, more manageable ride (6 gummies per bag, 3,000mg total). Sweet, sour, and just unexpected enough to keep things interesting.
